    sorted_calls = sorted(calls, key=lambda c: (-c['score'], c['start'], c['call_id']))

    selected = []

    for call in sorted_calls:
        start = call['start']
        end = call['end']
        # Check overlap with already selected spans

        if not overlap:

            occupied.update(range(start, end))
            selected.append(call)

    # Order accepted calls by source start ascending for reporting
    selected.sort(key=lambda c: c['start'])
    selected_call_ids = [c['call_id'] for c in selected]

    # Apply replacements from right to left (largest start first) to avoid offset shifts
    for call in reversed(selected):  # sorted by start ascending, reversed gives descending
        start = call['start']
        end = call['end']
        replacement = call['replacement_tokens']
        tokens = tokens[:start] + replacement + tokens[end:]

    return {
        'selected_call_ids': selected_call_ids,
        'tokens': tokens
    }
